title: Batch output-size journal drains without delaying shutdown classification
outcome: Output-size diagnostic drains use bounded batched journal I/O through the existing lifecycle owner while preserving panic/shutdown evidence and observation-only response delivery.
acceptance: Each output-size drain uses bounded batched journal I/O rather than one durable append per slot, through the existing lifecycle owner.
Shutdown and panic evidence semantics remain explicit and covered by tests; telemetry journal failures never affect HTTP/SSE delivery.
